tv results page.scripts:
<script type="text/javascript">
function refreshPage() 
{
var newUrl = location.href;
if( ExistParameter('rnd') )
{
var rndVal = GetParameterValue('rnd');
newUrl = newUrl.replace( rndVal, Math.random() );
}
Else
{
newUrl = newUrl + "?rnd=" + Math.random();
}
document.location = newUrl;
}
scrollRate=2;
</script>
